title: Lacy Kerala Appam from scratch 🥥🔥 #shorts

segments.moment_description: Preparing the rice batter to ferment
Blending the coconut into the batter
Cooking appam in the pan over fire
Eating appams together on the veranda

description:
Appam — Kerala's soft, lacy rice-and-coconut pancake, made from scratch 🥥🔥 Crisp golden edges, a fluffy spongy middle, cooked over fire in a traditional appachatti.

Appam with veg stew or egg curry — what's your combo? 👇 Comment below!

🌿 Made with fermented rice batter and fresh coconut — naturally light, soft and gluten-free.

Did you know? Appam gets its signature soft centre and lacy crisp rim from a naturally fermented rice-and-coconut batter swirled in a small round pan — a Kerala breakfast classic.
